configuration: provider.requests_per_minute optional; omitted retains previous no-pacing behavior. Set actual and example Azure configs to 2; actual retry max_attempts to 3.
pacing: At least 60/RPM seconds after previous counted attempt completion. Conservative extra spacing prevents subprocess startup variation from compressing request starts.
scope: One durable destination queue, all recorded provider attempts counted conservatively; local preflight failures before begin_attempt do not use slots.
history: Reuse attempts timestamps for restart-safe pacing. Minimal additive metadata only for provider Retry-After; no destructive schema migration.
ordering: Effective ready deadline gates before credential refresh or atomic queue claim. Preserve job-specific retry deadlines and global cooldown.
watch: Scan/admit between dispatches, not after draining all pending work; sources remain intact during backpressure.
safety: Bounded retries and conservative ambiguous-request handling unchanged. No live images, policy changes, credentials, or paid calls during implementation.
limitations: Does not coordinate separate destination databases or other Azure clients; independent token quotas may still produce 429.
